title: Temporary Total Past-Due on a Disability Compensation Award: Months and Payments Counted
content:
**1. Amount.** The temporary total past-due on a Disability Compensation award is the temporary total entitlement for the temporary total months, less what the award paid for those months, and never less than nothing; it is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**2. Temporary total months.** The temporary total months are the whole months elapsed from the temporary total rating's effective date to the effective date of the decision on the same claim recording that the prior rating resumed, and none while no such decision is recorded. The temporary total rating's effective date is the effective date on the most recent decision granting a temporary total rating.

**3. What the award paid.** What the award paid for the temporary total months is the gross of the monthly payments issued no fewer whole months before today than that resumption's effective date lies, and fewer whole months before today than the temporary total rating's effective date lies.

**4. Entitlement.** The temporary total entitlement for each temporary total month is the temporary total rate, 3938.58.

**Worked example (hypothetical award at Disability Compensation (50% Combined Rating); today 15 September 2026).**

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Temporary total rating effective | 10 February 2026 — 7 whole months before today |
| Decision on the same claim recording the prior rating resumed, effective | 10 May 2026 — 4 whole months before today |
| Temporary total months | 10 February to 10 May 2026: 3 |
| Monthly payments counted (issued 4, 5 or 6 whole months before today) | Those issued 1 March, 1 April and 1 May 2026, 1132.90 each: 3398.70 |
| Temporary total entitlement | 3938.58 multiplied by 3: 11815.74 |
| Temporary total past-due | 11815.74 less 3398.70: 8417.04 |

A payment issued on 1 June 2026 lies 3 whole months before today and is not counted; one issued on 1 February 2026 lies 7 whole months before today and is not counted either.
